rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously mentioned hidden reality
absolutive expressing prior act of cognition
abstract state of omniscience arising as result
verb indicating the emergence of omniscience

items.question: What realization arises from knowing the hidden true nature?
premises: A hidden true nature exists as an object of knowledge.
Knowing that hidden true nature is a decisive cognitive act.
All-knowingness can arise as a result of such knowledge.
items.inference: Therefore, having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
uncertainties: The precise referent of taṃ depends on the immediately preceding context.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
